text: Ciftoree aadi tiiɗɗo mbo Min keɓi e mon,wano goonɗinde Alla e nulaaɓe Mum,Min ɓamti haayre nde dow mon ngam hulɓinde on e reentinde on woppude gollirde aadi o,Min njamiri on njogoron Tawreeta nde Alla jippini e mon e soobee e tiiɗnaare, ko aldaa e aamre,ndeenee ko woni e mayre tesko-ɗon nde;na waawi ndaɗon lette Alla.
